title: ExternalIdentity
description: Verified subject binding between an external identity registration and a Principal.

created_at.description: UTC instant of initial durable creation. Server assigned.

version.description: Starts at 1. Increment exactly once per authoritative mutation.

updated_at.description: UTC instant of the latest authoritative mutation. Server assigned.

connection_id.description: Registered identity connection for this issuer and client context.

issuer.description: Exact issuer identifier from the trusted authentication configuration.

subject_fingerprint.description: Institution-scoped HMAC of exact issuer and subject in this connection.

protected_subject_ref.description: Restricted encrypted provider subject for reconciliation and key rotation.

state.description: Current lifecycle state. Mutate only through declared transitions.

x-invariants: A linked provider subject points to one Principal. This system refuses silent reassignment, email correlation, and accidental relinking of a tombstone.
Exact issuer and provider registration must match the token or trusted host assertion.
